title: AllocationDecision
description: What the LLM must emit, exactly. This schema is LOAD-BEARING: the agent holds a key and executes directly, and smaller open models produce malformed structured output. The harness validates against this and reject-and-retries on failure (agent/model/validation.py). Nothing reaches the chain unvalidated.

action.description: 'hold' is a first-class, frequently-correct answer. A model that never holds is a model that churns the vault.

reasoning.description: Why. Surfaced verbatim in the dApp decision feed — this is the product, not a debug field.

facts_used.description: MarketSnapshot fact ids that drove this decision. Lets the UI show data → reasoning → transaction, and lets us catch a model inventing numbers.

target_allocations.description: Desired end state as portfolio weights. Required when action != 'hold'. Weights must sum to ~1.0 (tolerance 0.01) and every asset must be in mandate.constraints.allowed_assets — the harness enforces both.

venue_intents.description: Venue-level intent, NOT calldata. The venue adapters (Lane D) turn these into an ExecutionPlan. The model never produces calldata.

mandate_amendment.description: Optional. The agent may amend its own mandate as it pursues it — the only actor permitted to. Applying this bumps Mandate.version and is recorded as an AgentAction.

patch.description: Partial Mandate; merged over the current one, then re-validated against mandate.schema.json.

oneOf.title: SwapIntent
oneOf.description: Rotate what the vault holds. Uniswap is the taker-side venue for this.

amount_in.description: Base units. Mutually exclusive with pct_of_holdings.

pct_of_holdings.description: Fraction of the vault's token_in balance. Easier for a model to get right than base units.

oneOf.title: AquaShipIntent
oneOf.description: Open/resize a market-making position. Tokens NEVER leave the vault — Aqua tracks virtual balances only, which is what preserves Pattern 1 custody.

program.description: SwapVM program parameters. Lane D compiles these to bytecode via the official Solidity ProgramBuilder — the model supplies parameters, never bytes.

oneOf.title: AquaDockIntent
oneOf.description: Close a position, returning virtual balances to free vault liquidity.

oneOf.title: SupplyIntent
oneOf.description: Deposit an asset into a lending market to earn interest. Closes the gap where the agent could read Aave's yields and had no intent type able to act on any of them. Custody is preserved — the vault supplies and holds the aToken itself, and onBehalfOf is always the vault.

amount.description: Base units. Mutually exclusive with pct_of_holdings.

pct_of_holdings.description: Fraction of the vault's balance of this asset.

oneOf.title: WithdrawIntent
oneOf.description: Redeem a supplied asset from a lending market back into the vault.

amount.description: Omit for all of it. The adapter sends type(uint256).max, which is how Aave expresses a full withdrawal without racing interest accrued between quoting and mining.

uint256String.description: Decimal string. Never a JSON number — uint256 exceeds float64.
